## Risk tier

<!-- See ADR 0017. The label is applied automatically; describe anything reviewers should know. -->

- [ ] low — docs, added tests, translations, patch dependency bumps
- [ ] medium — feature code inside a module
- [ ] high — identity, permissions, crypto, DB migrations, agent, public API contracts, CI config, licenses, or removing/weakening tests
